blocks.title: How the design language works.
blocks.lead: The tokens, shapes, motion and components behind every Etesian screen, running live from the design library: flip, drag and press them.

items.title: Content before chrome
items.text: the toolbar below is the only chrome a page gets.

items.title: Gestures, not buttons
items.text: no app draws a close button; the swipe from the edge does it.

items.title: Calm by default
items.text: a notification is a short banner, then waits in Events.

items.title: Faithful first
items.text: on the phone, every extra in Etesian Settings starts switched off.

blocks.heading: Tokens
blocks.intro: Colours, type, sizes, radii and timings are design tokens: one JSON file in the design repository, published as CSS custom properties and TypeScript. These demos read them from the package.

items.title: Colour.
items.caption: The N9 palette for light and dark pages, and an accent per app (Phone green, Messages cyan, Calendar orange). Used for every page background, text colour and app header.

items.title: Type.
items.caption: The type scale from the N9’s own sizes, set in open fonts (Fira Sans on this site). Headings are light and large; body text is plain.

items.title: The squircle.
items.caption: Icons, avatars and thumbnails are superellipses, never circles or rounded squares. Drag the slider to compare.

items.title: Motion.
items.caption: The N9’s timings and curves: things arrive easing out, leave easing in. Press Play. With reduced motion set, nothing animates.

items.title: See-through chrome.
items.caption: Bars over content, like this site’s header and the camera’s controls, let the content show through, blurred.

blocks.heading: Components
blocks.intro: The Vue components (Hd*) in @etesian-design/vue, live. How they reach this site, Cloud Companion and the Storybook is on the Web page.

items.title: Buttons, segments, switches and fields.
items.caption: Buttons and fields end in half a squircle; switches are the N9’s flip switches. Used in every settings page and form.

items.title: Fast scroll.
items.caption: Scroll the list, or drag the letters on the right: a big letter shows while you drag. Used in Contacts, Applications and every long list.

items.title: Menus, dialogs and sheets.
items.caption: The app menu, a question that needs an answer, and a sheet for a short task. Used across the apps.

items.title: Page header, list and toolbar.
items.caption: A plain page header, list rows, and the N9 bottom toolbar with Back at the left; tap the star. Used by every app page.

items.title: Notification styles.
items.caption: Pick a style: a banner for a message, a toast with an action, a short info banner for a confirmation.

items.title: Icons with N9 lighting.
items.caption: App icons are lit from the top: gradient, rim and a short shadow. Switch it off to see the flat version.

blocks.heading: Fonts and assets
paragraphs: The fonts are open (Fira Sans, Ubuntu Sans, Archivo); the sounds, boot animation and wallpapers are made for the project.

home.title: Calm, gesture-first, content before chrome.
home.lead: Etesian is a way of designing as much as a piece of software. Its influence is the Nokia N9's Swipe UI, re-envisioned for today’s screens.

items.title: Content before chrome
items.text: Screens show what matters; controls step back. One row of chrome, never two.

items.title: Gestures, not buttons
items.text: The edges of the screen minimise and close, everywhere, the same way. Nothing in an app imitates them.

items.title: Calm by default
items.text: Nothing shouts for attention. Everything that happened waits in one place: Events.

items.title: Faithful first
items.text: The N9 behaviour is the default. Every addition is optional and starts switched off.

items.title: The squircle
items.text: Every thumb-sized shape, from app icons to avatars, is a superellipse measured from the N9’s own icons. Never a circle, never a rounded square.

items.title: Lit from the top
items.text: Icons and buttons are lit objects: a soft gradient, a thin rim, a gentle sheen.

items.title: Light, large type
items.text: Big, thin headings and plain text. Type follows the system’s size and weight settings.

items.title: Colour that means something
items.text: Each app has its own colour, used on its main header and icon. Sub pages stay plain.

items.title: Black home, light pages
items.text: The home views are black; apps are light. Dark and light modes keep the same structure.

items.title: Motion with purpose
items.text: Apps slide in, slide away when minimised and follow the finger when closed. No splash screens.

home.heading: Heritage
paragraphs: The design language is built from careful study of the N9 (2011): its gestures, proportions and behaviour. Where the N9 had no answer, for larger screens, a pointer or a keyboard, the gaps are filled in the same spirit. No Nokia images, sounds or fonts are used.
